list.title: ITaaS Agency - Landing Page
list.subheading: Landing page for a business that offers IT-as-a-Service services.
list.excerpt: A proof-of-concept landing page for a fictitious IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) company to showcase its services and facilitate customer engagement. The website highlights the benefits of using the company's services and provides a way for potential customers to contact the business.

list.title: Personal Portfolio (V2)
list.subheading: A Next.js/MDX portfolio with its own content-clone pipeline
list.excerpt: A Next.js static portfolio that clones a private MDX content repo at build time, renders typed collections through a ContentRepository, and deploys to AWS S3 + CloudFront across develop, stage, and production.
list.problem: A hand-rolled static site could not keep up with real content authoring, typed collections, or multi-environment deploys.
list.approach: Next.js 13 SSG with MDX, atomic SCSS modules, a build-time content-repo clone, and a branch-gated S3/CloudFront CI/CD pipeline.
list.outcome: Ran as the live personal site for years and established the content-at-build pattern that v3 later evolved into a SQLite pipeline.

list.title: GitHub Actions: An In-Depth Guide to Automating Your Software Development Lifecycle
list.subheading: A Comprehensive Overview of GitHub Actions' Features and Best Practices
list.excerpt: Dive into the power of GitHub Actions for automating your software development lifecycle. Explore features, best practices, and code examples to get the most out of this robust platform.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Deploy Vite React with React Router App to GitHub Pages
list.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Deploying Vite-React Projects on GitHub Pages
list.excerpt: Looking to deploy your Vite React app with React Router to GitHub Pages? This step-by-step guide will walk you through the process, covering everything from GitHub Actions to common pitfalls.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: How to Automate Static Asset Deployment with CI/CD (No Manual Steps)
list.subheading: Cut release time in half by integrating asset builds directly into your pipeline

list.title: pull_request vs. pull_request_target: The GitHub Actions Trigger Hiding a Security Nightmare
list.subheading: Understanding the critical difference between these two triggers and why one could give attackers RCE on your repository.
list.excerpt: Learn the security-critical distinction between `pull_request` and `pull_request_target` in GitHub Actions. One is safe for forks, the other could expose your secrets and code.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Am I Vulnerable? How to Audit Your GitHub Actions for the pull_request_target Flaw
list.subheading: A practical guide to finding and fixing the common misconfiguration that allows untrusted code to run with privileged access.
list.excerpt: Audit your GitHub workflows for a critical security flaw. This guide helps you identify if your use of `pull_request_target` is checking out untrusted code.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: The 'Pull Request Nightmare': How RCE Was Found in Google & Microsoft Repos
list.subheading: A deep dive into the critical security flaw discovered by Orca Security (roin-orca) and how it turned simple PRs into critical threats.
list.excerpt: Explore the `pull_request_target` vulnerability found by Orca Security. See how Fortune-100 companies were exposed to RCE from a single malicious pull request.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: 3 Ways to Secure Your GitHub Workflows from Malicious Pull Requests
list.subheading: Don't get hacked. Implement these best practices today to safely handle pull requests from forks without disabling your automations.
list.excerpt: Secure your GitHub Actions. Learn 3 essential mitigation techniques: checking PR origins, using manual approval labels, and gating jobs with environments.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Why Is pull_request_target So Dangerous? A Security Explainer
list.subheading: It runs in the context of the base repo, has access to your secrets, and can run untrusted code. Here's what you need to know.
list.excerpt: The `pull_request_target` trigger in GitHub Actions is a major security risk if misused. Understand why it's dangerous and how it exposes repository secrets.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: From Fork to RCE: Deconstructing the Orca Security GitHub Actions Exploit
list.subheading: Following the attacker's path, from creating a malicious fork to exfiltrating API keys and pushing code to protected branches.
list.excerpt: A step-by-step breakdown of the 'Pull Request Nightmare' exploit. See how attackers leverage `pull_request_target` to achieve RCE and steal secrets.
list.author: Paul Serban
